WITH apply_summary AS ( SELECT data_key, COALESCE(SUM(apply_num), 0) AS apply_num_sum, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'SCBL' THEN apply_num ELSE 0 END), 0) AS scbl_apply_num_sum FROM ${dynamicTableNameProxy.outStockApply} WHERE delete_flag = false AND contract_code = #{requestData.contractCode} GROUP BY data_key ) SELECT t2.unity_no AS unityNo, t2.product_part_sign name, t2.model, case when #{type} = 0 then t.order_quantity else GREATEST((COALESCE(t.order_quantity,0) - COALESCE(t.schedule_quantity,0) + COALESCE(a.scbl_apply_num_sum,0)), 0) end as order_quantity, t3.pieces_sign AS pcsChn, COALESCE(a.apply_num_sum, 0) AS applyNum, COALESCE(a.scbl_apply_num_sum, 0) AS scblApplyNumSum, t.outbound_quantity, t4.shipping_space::BIGINT[] AS shippingSpaces, COALESCE(t4.total_inventory,0) AS total_inventory, COALESCE(t4.lock_in_inventor,0) AS lock_in_inventor, t4.primary_key AS stockCode, t4.stock_init_state AS stock_init_state, t.primary_key, COALESCE(t.accrual_lock_in_inventory,0) AS accrual_lock_in_inventory, t.collaborate_material, t.schedule_quantity, COALESCE(t.ingredient_out_quantity,0) as ingredient_out_quantity, t.contract_number FROM ${dynamicTableNameProxy.collaborateScheduleItem} t LEFT JOIN apply_summary a ON t.primary_key = a.data_key LEFT JOIN ${dynamicTableNameProxy.productPart} t2 ON t.collaborate_material = t2.primary_key LEFT JOIN ${dynamicTableNameProxy.productPiece} t3 ON t2.pcs = t3.primary_key LEFT JOIN ${dynamicTableNameProxy.stock} t4 ON t2.primary_key = t4.product_part_code WHERE t.delete_flag = false AND t.enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} and t.contract_code = #{requestData.contractCode}
and GREATEST(t.order_quantity, 0) > 0 AND t.material_nature is null and t.collaborate_type = 0
and GREATEST(t.order_quantity - t.schedule_quantity, 0) > 0 AND t.material_nature = 'PRODUCE' and t.collaborate_type = 1 and t.schedule_quantity < t.order_quantity
and GREATEST(t.order_quantity - t.schedule_quantity, 0) > 0 AND t.material_nature = 'OUT_SEND' and t.collaborate_type = 1 and t.schedule_quantity < t.order_quantity
ORDER BY t.create_time DESC,t.id desc

SELECT contract_number, contract_code, sell_order_code, SUM(order_quantity) as totalProductOrderQuantity, SUM(schedule_quantity) as totalProductScheduleQuantity FROM ${dynamicTableNameProxy.collaborateScheduleItem} WHERE delete_flag = false and enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} and sell_order_code = #{sellOrderCode} and collaborate_type = 0 GROUP BY contract_number, contract_code, sell_order_code

SELECT contract_number, contract_code, sell_order_code, collaborate_material, SUM(order_quantity) as totalOrderQuantity, SUM(schedule_quantity) as totalScheduleQuantity, SUM(material_produce_quantity) as totalMaterialProduceQuantity, SUM(COALESCE(material_purchase_quantity, 0)) as totalMaterialPurchaseQuantity, SUM(COALESCE(material_out_bound_quantity, 0)) as totalMaterialOutBoundQuantity, SUM(COALESCE(ingredient_out_quantity, 0)) as totalIngredientOutQuantity FROM ${dynamicTableNameProxy.collaborateScheduleItem} WHERE delete_flag = false and enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} and sell_order_code = #{sellOrderCode} and collaborate_type = 0 GROUP BY contract_number, contract_code, sell_order_code, collaborate_material

with a as (select product_part_code, sum(out_num) total from ${dynamicTableNameProxy.stagingArea} a where delete_flag = false and enterprise_code = ${dynamicTableNameProxy.enterpriseCode} and contract_code = #{contractCode} group by product_part_code) , b as (select * from ${dynamicTableNameProxy.collaborateScheduleItem} WHERE delete_flag = false and enterprise_code = ${dynamicTableNameProxy.enterpriseCode} and contract_code = #{contractCode} and collaborate_type = 0 and can_produce = true)
select b.* from b left join a on b.collaborate_material = a.product_part_code where order_quantity - coalesce(total, 0) > 0 limit 1

WITH apply_summary AS (SELECT data_key, COALESCE(SUM(apply_num), 0) AS apply_num_sum, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'SCBL' THEN apply_num ELSE 0 END), 0) AS scbl_apply_num_sum FROM ${dynamicTableNameProxy.outStockApply} WHERE delete_flag = false AND product_part_code = #{productPartCode} AND enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} GROUP BY data_key) SELECT t.contract_code as contractCode, t.contract_number as contractNumber, t.enterprise_code as enterpriseCode, t.collaborate_material as productOrPart, COALESCE(a.apply_num_sum, 0) AS collaborateOutApplyNum, case when t.collaborate_type = 0 then t.order_quantity else GREATEST((COALESCE(t.order_quantity, 0) - COALESCE(t.schedule_quantity, 0) + COALESCE(a.scbl_apply_num_sum, 0)), 0) end as outTotal, t.outbound_quantity as outNum, t4.primary_key AS collaborateStockCode, COALESCE(t4.total_inventory, 0) AS totalInventory, t.primary_key AS collaborateDateKey, t.schedule_quantity AS collaborateScheduleQuantity FROM ${dynamicTableNameProxy.collaborateScheduleItem} t LEFT JOIN apply_summary a ON t.primary_key = a.data_key LEFT JOIN ${dynamicTableNameProxy.stock} t4 ON t.collaborate_material = t4.product_part_code WHERE t.delete_flag = false AND t.enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} AND t4.enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} AND t.collaborate_material = #{productPartCode} -- AND (t.product_out_finish IS NULL OR t.product_out_finish = 'f') AND ( (t.collaborate_type = 0 AND COALESCE(t.order_quantity,0) > COALESCE(t.outbound_quantity,0)) OR (t.collaborate_type != 0 AND GREATEST((COALESCE(t.order_quantity,0) - COALESCE(t.schedule_quantity,0) + COALESCE(a.scbl_apply_num_sum,0)), 0) > COALESCE(t.outbound_quantity,0)) ) AND COALESCE(t4.total_inventory, 0) - COALESCE(t.accrual_lock_in_inventory, 0) > 0 ORDER BY t.create_time DESC LIMIT 1
